YOUR ADVENTURE GUIDE

How to Play

Start in Genesis and follow the journey through Bible history. Each solved word reveals an original scene from the account.

Make words: Glide across the circular letters or tap them in order. Use Hint when you need a nudge.

Explore: Journey shows the animated timeline. Levels lists Bible books and the episodes you've unlocked.

Creation is complete and the first Eden scenes are playable after you finish Creation. Insight Tokens buy optional hints and collectibles; Points track achievement. Check Rewards for your seven-day journey.

About Bible Unfolded

✦

Made to be enjoyed and shared

I want everyone to enjoy and benefit from Bible Unfolded. I've put many hours of work into creating a fun way to explore accurate Bible knowledge and truth.

I'll keep reviewing the content, improving the game, and adding new discoveries as we go.

♡ Free for everyone

The game is free to play. Voluntary donations are appreciated and help cover development and future updates, but are never required.
